label: Wheel Stance
description: How the front wheels sit: steering pose and camber attitude — composes with any viewing angle.

items.name: straight-aligned
items.text: Front wheels aligned dead straight, a clean, planted, factory-precise stance.

items.name: toe-in-aggressive
items.text: Front wheels turned slightly inward, coiled and aggressive, as if set for a corner entry.

items.name: toe-out-wide
items.text: Front wheels angled slightly outward, widening the stance and squaring the shoulders of the car.

items.name: negative-camber
items.text: Visible negative camber leaning the wheel tops inward, performance-set suspension geometry.

items.name: steering-full-lock
items.text: Front wheels at full steering lock, rim faces presented to the camera in show-stance drama.

items.name: forward-rake
items.text: Nose-down forward rake, the front end sitting a finger lower than the rear, hunkered like a sprinter in the blocks.
